edges.reason: constructor assigns gov from msg.sender, defining the entire permission model
rebase checks msg.sender == tx.origin || msg.sender == gov before executing
tx.origin comparison allows any externally owned account to trigger a rebase
rebase uses now for the min interval check and to snap the rebase timestamp
_inRebaseWindow relies on now.mod(...) to accept or reject the rebase
minRebaseTimeIntervalSec defines the modulo period of the rebase window
rebaseWindowOffsetSec bounds the earliest allowed rebase time
rebaseWindowLengthSec bounds the latest allowed rebase time
rebasingActive gates the entire rebase window check
rebase calls _inRebaseWindow to validate timing
lastRebaseTimestampSec is read and rewritten by rebase
epoch is incremented and passed to yuan.rebase
rebase writes the incremented epoch back to storage
rebase reads rebaseMintPercs to compute per-reserve mint amounts
rebaseMintPercs values flow into the unchecked percentage sum
rebase computes rebaseMintPerc as an unchecked SUM of the three percentages
rebase performs an external privileged call to yuan.rebase

rebase obtains the market exchange rate

normalization_plan.reason: amount0 is only consumed by the swap callback when computing the reserve token payout
amount1 is only consumed by the swap callback when computing the reserve token payout
the encoded UniVars blob is decoded exclusively inside the swap callback
mintAmount is the treasury mint supplied by afterRebase to size the swap
offPegPerc is used only to bound the swap size through uniswapMaxSlippage
destination is the call target of the low-level call wrapper
calldata is forwarded verbatim into the low-level call wrapper
exchangeRate is a transient value computed and consumed only inside rebase
indexDelta is computed, dampened and consumed only inside rebase
mintAmounts is derived in rebase and only forwarded to afterRebase
token0Reserves is a transient read used only to size the swap
token1Reserves is a transient read used only to size the swap
the slippage bound result is a local used only for the swap branch selection
excess is the transient treasury balance driving the swap tier selection
UniVars is the transient struct passed from the swap initiator to the callback
timeElapsed is a transient divisor computed only in the TWAP routine
priceAverage is the transient TWAP value returned by the getTWAP routine
